facts.fact: The page states that every year approximately $18 billion in sales is lost because people abandon shopping carts.
facts.quote: Every year, an almost unbelievable **$18 billion** in sales is lost simply because people abandon their shopping carts.

facts.fact: The page states that studies show the average cart abandonment rate across all industries is 70.22%.
facts.quote: studies show the average cart abandonment rate across all industries is a staggering **70.22%**.

facts.fact: The page claims that personalizing abandoned cart emails effectively yields 26% higher open rates.
facts.quote: We're talking **26% higher open rates** and a massive **41% lift in click-through rates** when you personalize effectively.

facts.fact: The page states that sending a series of three timed abandoned cart emails has been shown to recover 37% more carts than sending one email.
facts.quote: Sending a series of three timed emails has been shown to recover **37% more carts** than just sending one.

facts.fact: The page cites a sample social proof line stating 'Join over 500 happy customers who love this!' as an example for abandoned cart emails.
facts.quote: A simple line like, "Join **over 500 happy customers** who love this!" can work wonders.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends sending the first abandoned cart email 1 hour after the customer abandons the cart.
facts.quote: My rule of thumb? Send it in the first hour.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends sending the second abandoned cart email about 24 hours after abandonment.
facts.quote: 24 hours** after abandonment.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends sending the third abandoned cart email 3-5 days after abandonment.
facts.quote: 3-5 days** after abandonment.

facts.fact: The vendor advises against offering a discount in the first abandoned cart email.
facts.quote: Don't offer a discount yet.

facts.fact: The vendor suggests a soft incentive in the second email, such as free shipping or a modest 10% discount.
facts.quote: offering **free shipping** (always a winner) or a modest **10% discount**

facts.fact: According to the vendor, Adwave places AI-driven ads across over 100 premium channels.
facts.quote: place AI-driven ads across over **100** premium channels

facts.fact: Open rate is the percentage of recipients who open an email.
facts.quote: It’s the percentage of people who bothered to open your email.

facts.fact: The page's rule of thumb says a solid abandoned cart sequence should reach an open rate of 40% or more.
facts.quote: As a rule of thumb, a solid abandoned cart sequence should be hitting open rates of **40%** or more

facts.fact: The page's rule of thumb gives a click-through rate of around 10% as a benchmark for a solid abandoned cart sequence.
facts.quote: a CTR around **10%**, and a conversion rate anywhere from **5-15%**

facts.fact: The page's rule of thumb gives a conversion rate range of 5-15% as a benchmark for a solid abandoned cart sequence.
facts.quote: a conversion rate anywhere from **5-15%**

facts.fact: The page calls a 10% discount a solid, common starting point for a cart recovery incentive, to be introduced only after the first reminder.
facts.quote: A **10% discount** is a solid, common starting point that often does the trick.

facts.fact: The page advises introducing a modest discount in the second or third cart recovery email, not the first, if the customer has not yet converted.
facts.quote: you can introduce a modest discount in your second or third email

facts.fact: Under CAN-SPAM (U.S.), the page says abandoned cart emails must include the sender's physical business address.
facts.quote: Your emails must include your physical business address

facts.fact: Under CAN-SPAM (U.S.), the page says unsubscribe requests must be honored immediately.
facts.quote: you have to honor any unsubscribe requests immediately

facts.fact: Under GDPR (Europe), the page says a clear opt-out must be provided in every single abandoned cart email sent.
facts.quote: you absolutely must provide a crystal-clear way for people to opt out in every single email you send
